name: ephemeris
description: Issue-based daily handoffs for coding agents: pass source addresses between sessions instead of re-summarising context

interface.shortDescription: Daily handoffs that pass addresses, not summaries
interface.longDescription: One GitHub issue holds the state of a project day. When a session ends it leaves stable addresses — comment IDs, issues, commits, ctx citations — and the next session resolves them and reports whatever it cannot open.
defaultPrompt: Заведи дейлик на сегодня и перенеси незакрытое.
